details.direction: Point-to-point from the three Greenwich/Blackheath start lines to The Mall
details.distanceMethod: Official course page: 26.2 miles. The 2026 participant guide is used for race-day details but does not state the total mileage; the event overview gives the gain but no total mileage. The official route embedded on the course page displays 26.1 miles. This entity stores the standard marathon distance of 42,195 m; the official 26.2 miles is the rounded form of that distance, and the official pages do not state the full distance in kilometres.
details.elevationMethod: Official event overview: 246 feet (74.98 m, rounded to 75 m). The official route embedded on the course page displays 278 feet (about 85 m); the course page text publishes no gain. This entity uses the event-overview figure.
